subject: Request to shift technical demo — week of company blackout
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Tom Huang <tom.huang@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro — Redwood Inference technical demo (Dec 1 slot)

Hi Kimberly / Tom,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Our engineering and platform teams are keen to see the end-to-end inference flow and a short walkthrough of the cost/latency controls you mentioned. We have a tentative slot on Monday, Dec 1 at 10:00 AM PT.

Attendees: Sarah Lee (platform), Tom Huang (infra), Priya (ML).

Can you confirm the demo length you recommend and whether you can cover live traffic shaping and fallback policies? We can be flexible if you need to move.

Also attaching our short prep doc (see note below).

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Platform Lead, Acme Corporation
[sent from mobile]

Attachment: acme-prep-notes.txt (text, 4KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro — Redwood Inference technical demo (Dec 1 slot)

Hi Sarah — thanks for lining this up. 10:00 AM PT on Dec 1 would normally work, but I need to flag a calendar constraint on our side: Redwood is doing a company-wide operations blackout the week of Nov 30–Dec 4 (year-end patching + leadership offsite). A few of our product engineers will be traveling to RSA that week as well, which affects the folks who would run a full technical walkthrough.

Options I can offer today:
- Move to the week after (Dec 8–12): we can block 60 minutes and include live traffic shaping, fallback policy, and a short Q&A. I can get Marissa and Rishi to lead the demo.
- Keep Dec 1 but trim to a 30-minute executive overview (Kimberly + product PM only) — good if you want a high-level pass and then follow with a technical session later.
- If you need hands-on metrics, we can run the full technical session Dec 10 at 11:00 AM PT (engineering-attendee guaranteed).

Please let me know which you'd prefer. I attached an updated demo deck and a proposed mutual action plan to speed approvals if you want to move forward with Dec 10.

Apologies for the inconvenience — we try to avoid blackout weeks but this one lines up with multiple obligations.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

Attachments:
- demo-deck-v3.pdf (PDF, 2MB)
- mutual-action-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)

Thanks for the details, Sarah — sorry for the holiday overlap. A few practical notes from engineering:

- If you want hands-on traffic shaping and KV cache demos, the session works best with 3 engineers (model serving, infra, and integrations). We can't guarantee that on Dec 1.
- Proposed concrete alternatives: Dec 9 at 11:00 AM PT or Dec 10 at 11:00 AM PT (both 60-min slots).
- If you prefer Dec 1 for an exec-level overview, we can do 30 minutes covering platform capabilities, then schedule a technical deep-dive Dec 10.

I've updated the mutual-action-plan.xlsx with recommended attendees and prep items to minimize back-and-forth — link included. If you confirm Dec 9/10, I'll lock the engineer calendar invites and add a short runbook for the demo so we don't need a long pre-call.

Quick ask from Acme to speed procurement: if the team wants to evaluate cost-at-scale numbers we can provide an informal projection during the technical session, but formal pricing will require an account manager touch (I can loop in Sales Ops).

—Marissa
